hotels.title: Top-Rated Singapore Escape near Orchard Road with Two Onsite Restaurants & Bar
hotels.description: Discover Singapore's vibrant fusion of cultures, iconic sightseeing and unforgettable cuisine in signature luxury at JEN Singapore Tanglin by Shangri-La, a playful property ranked in the top 10% of hotels worldwide by Tripadvisor. Singapore is renowned for its cuisine, from street food hawker fare in Chinatown to Michelin-starred fine dining. Here, you can enjoy an authentic, mouthwatering feast without leaving your hotel. J65 serves up hot, home-style dishes alongside fresh seafood, Ah Hoi's Kitchen is all about authentic Singaporean cuisine and Rumpoles Bar is your go-to for a Singapore-inspired craft cocktail in an exclusive club-like setting. When you're not wining and dining, make use of the hotel's 24-hour gym or take a dip in the outdoor swimming pool and whirlpool. When you’re ready to explore the wonders Singapore has to offer, Orchard Road's retail heaven is just a short walk away, while the open-air food street of Chinatown, where you'll find your next great feed, is a 10-minute drive. Slightly further are the jaw-dropping garden displays of the iconic Gardens by the Bay and Marina Bay Sands.

hotels.title: Singapore City Escape near Orchard Road with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Cocktails & Club Lounge Access
hotels.description: Part of the trusted Shangri-La family, JEN Singapore Tanglin delivers the brand's hallmark service in one of the city's most convenient addresses, located just minutes from Orchard Road. Sitting quietly in the Tanglin neighbourhood, this city break hotel strikes a balance between the energy of Singapore's most famous shopping strip and the calm of the nearby UNESCO-listed Botanic Gardens. With access to Club JEN @ 17 included, it's your invitation to live large in one of the most incredible cities in the world. The large outdoor pool and sun deck give guests a proper retreat between city explorations, while the full-service spa completes the set with a sauna and steam room. Club JEN @ 17 is the hotel's standout hangout, dedicated to a lavish afternoon tea and evening cocktails and canapes, transforming your stay from perfectly comfortable to positively indulgent.
